text:
elaine_support: ACME reporting their A/B dashboard shows variant B ~200% of expected and variant A near zero. Started after last night deploy. @zach @mike can you triage?

ops-bot: deploy complete: release/runtime 2026-03-16_23:42 by beth_eng — tag r-infer-2.7.2 — CI run 4721

mike_data: can you paste exp id + timeframe? customer said experiment id exp_9f3a and window 2026-03-16 00:00 -> 03:00 UTC

elaine_support: yes: exp_9f3a, customer project acme-prod, noticed A=~150k, B=~320k in dashboard - counts inconsistent with server logs that show ~150k total. Repro steps: open rollout dashboard -> cohort breakdown -> last 24h.

zach_platform: quick theory — we changed rollout hash seed in runtime to improve distribution (seed 1234 -> 4321) in the release. If ingestion uses old seed but serving uses new seed, dashboard assignment mapping may double-count or shift variants.

mike_data: if true, the assignments in events would map to old variant ids but the dashboard join uses new variant_id -> name mapping causing dupes. Check `variant_hash_seed` in ingest logs.

elaine_support: grabbing logs... snippet:

```
ingest-processor[pid:88] INFO assigner: variant_hash_seed=1234 exp=exp_9f3a bucket=42 -> variant=beta
runtime[pid:21] INFO rollout: computed seed=4321 exp=exp_9f3a user=usr_99 -> variant=alpha
```

mike_data: yep, mismatch. That will explain both missing A and >expected B (mapping shifted). Need to decide: rollback runtime to old seed ASAP OR do mapping backfill to translate old->new variant ids in analytics.

zach_platform: rollback will fix live assignment going forward. But dashboard historical counts will still be off unless we re-run translation on event store. I recommend: 1) rollback runtime to seed=1234 (cut a patch) 2) run a deterministic mapping job to remap events for exp_9f3a from seed 1234 -> seed 4321 so dashboard aligns (or revert mapping logic in dashboard join to use seed stamped on event). Also surface a temp banner in console.

beth_eng: starting rollback now, ETA 20m. Opening a support ticket and notifying ACME. ticket# SUP-4389

mike_data: For backfill, I can run a translation job: SQL to detect anomalies:

```
SELECT variant_old, COUNT(*) FROM assignments
WHERE exp_id='exp_9f3a' AND ts >= '2026-03-16'
GROUP BY variant_old;
```

Then map variant_old -> variant_new using deterministic rehash function. I'll schedule it after rollback.

elaine_support: ACME notified. They're asking if this impacted billing. Any idea?

zach_platform: counts for usage may be duplicated only in analytics reports, billing pipeline uses raw request tokens and is agnostic to variant mapping. Still confirm.

mike_data: Confirmed: billing totals unchanged. Dashboard-only inconsistency.

beth_eng: rollback complete. runtime seed=1234. Monitoring.

ops-bot: incident: analytics-dashboard-deviation created: INC-20260316-57 assigned to mike_data, zach_platform

mike_data: I'll kick off backfill for exp_9f3a and put results to a staging dashboard, will attach query and PR. ETA 4 hours.

elaine_support: thanks, pls add short postmortem blurb for ACME.

beth_eng: noted. will follow up with postmortem and changelog entry about seed changes and assume we need safer migration path (feature flag + staged seed rollout).

mike_data: action items: rollback (done), backfill job (in progress), console banner (zach), postmortem (beth). I'll update ticket SUP-4389 with timestamps.

elaine_support: appreciated :thumbsup:
